setlist.info: Springsteen played at a church. Venue listed is a placeholder. On 30th July, Terry Magovern, long time associate and close friend to Bruce passed away. At Terry Magovern's memorial service Bruce performed a new song called "Terry's Song". Bruce said he went through his songbook and was looking for an appropriate song to play for Terry..."Out of all my songs, there was nothing I could find. So I wrote this song." "Terry's Song" was later added as an unlisted bonus track on the Magic album.
